frozen_model_level_claim: A meta-learned plastic recurrent network can transform sparse, partially encoded signed evidence into coherent yet individualized Liu-style rankings through two causally distinct expression routes: selectively admitted evidence feeds P_T for coherent remote and nonlearned assembly, while broader weak observed evidence feeds a_T for query-addressed direct fidelity. This organization transports across the prospectively registered one-factor topology, presentation-order, sparsity, and N=6/8/10 item-count studies within their exact boundaries.
frozen_positive_outcomes: six of nine registered Liu behavioral phenomena are quantitatively reproduced and three are qualitatively reproduced but quantitatively mismatched
replicated P_T/a_T causal double dissociation and fresh-backbone confirmation of differential evidence admission
all competence, global-causal, local-causal, and exact-compression links pass in all 24 sparsity cells
frozen_negative_boundaries: SPARSITY_DEPENDENT_OR_UNRESOLVED remains the parent sparsity outcome because one E=10 individualized-stability interval misses its frozen threshold
denser evidence produces replicated order convergence without replicated loss of binary stable-error incidence
symbolic-distance slope is too steep, serial-position endpoint contrast is too weak, and seed 2104 overproduces inconsistent rankings
N=10 retains the mechanism but has lower nonlearned accuracy, Hodge-order alignment, and remote magnitude together with a larger normalized distance slope
the transport studies are sequential one-factor tests, not a factorial cross-product or arbitrary-scale guarantee
claim_exclusions: unique tensor-product code or distinct biological memory stores
arbitrary topology, density, presentation schedule, or item-count transport
perfect quantitative reproduction of all Liu phenomena

freeze_policy.immutable: Do not edit, overwrite, retune, or reinterpret the registered contracts, locks, results, reports, or evidence manifest covered by this freeze.
freeze_policy.reporting_allowed: Add derived presentation, manuscript, navigation, and figure materials only when they cite frozen sources and introduce no new estimand or model output.
freeze_policy.correction_policy: Record a factual correction as an append-only erratum with the affected path and old/new hashes; do not silently rewrite frozen evidence.
freeze_policy.new_science_policy: Any cardinality-sensitive global-policy analysis or other model experiment is a new scientific program requiring its own prospective contract and namespace.
parked: list linking and classic transitive inference
new global compression or parameter tuning
